title: I made a Unity Editor chat for Claude Code no API key required everything working directly from Unity and i want to open-source it
author: Lightnig125
selftext:
Hello everyone ! 

  
I don’t know if some people here use Unity. But i’ve been experimenting with MCP + Unity because i wanted to use Claude Code directly inside the Unity Editor.

From what I could see, using Unity’s official MCP / AI workflow seemed to require a paid Unity AI plan, around $10/month. I didn’t really want another subscription just to connect my editor to an AI agent.

It adds a dockable chat window directly inside Unity and talks to Claude Code already authenticated on my machine and no api key is required.

I’m thinking about releasing it open source on GitHub if you think it could be useful

Would you use something like this ?

What would you expect from a tool like this before trusting it in a real project ?

There are still quite a few things I’d like to add before making it public. But i think it's really interesting to be able to control Unity from Claude Code and directly inside the editor
